scope: Corollary 3.3 (Radial comparison of exponential determinants) of the manuscript “Uniform Bi-Holder Transport from Weak MTW” (preprints/Uniform-Bi-Holder-Transport-from-Weak-MTW-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 360 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1e1a412dff1dd263), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 10-11. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: With a constant depending only on (M, g), if v ∈ Gx and 1/2 ≤ θ ≤ 1, then σx(θv) ≥ cσx(v). (3.16) Suppose y = expx p, p ∈ Gx, and p̄ = −Px→yp. If l ∈ [1/2, 1) and p̄/l ∈ Gy, then σy(p̄/l) ≤ Cσx(p). (3.17) 10 If l+ ∈ [1, 2], then σy(p̄/l+) ≥ cσx(p). (3.18) Comparison (3.17) permits the longer reversed vector p̄/l to have a conjugate endpoint.
